decisions.reason: The glass flake two-component spraying system extends the firm's core coating know-how into corrosion-protection niches, and one year on the market is too short to judge it against aspirations; it is only mentioned on the website, but the firm's slack lets it carry the product while results remain uncertain.

The low-pressure injection pump is close to the established construction-repair offer and has its own website page, so it fits existing customers and channels, carries low risk, and gives no shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of the resources.

The multi-model transfer pump line builds on core conveying competence and serves a broad industrial customer base, so its resource demands are modest and early performance is unlikely to fall below aspiration enough to justify withdrawal.

Fire protection flow monitoring is somewhat further from the core and its demand is still uncertain, but its own website page and fit with the digitalization strategy suggest commitment, and slack allows the firm to keep it while learning.
